$comment: This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the expected values. The guard
(check-cyclomatic-bound.ts) reads the ACTUAL values from .oxlintrc.json and
compares them against this reference file.
TWO LAYERS OF DEFENSE (both machine-enforced in CI as of #1661):
Independently asserts these exact values via DOCUMENTED_POLICY, so
editing both this file AND .oxlintrc.json together to a relaxed ceiling
(e.g. __default__: 125 with no zone overrides) fails the test. A ceiling
change that relaxes any bound therefore requires editing THREE files:
DOCUMENTED_POLICY — all three must agree for CI to remain green.
The keys are the glob patterns that appear as `files` entries in .oxlintrc.json
overrides. The special key "__default__" maps to the root-level rules.complexity.
